items.reason: Describes JavaScript injection through the referer interpolated into the embed layout. No golden issue describes this interpolation vulnerability.
Both describe contents << mutating the caller's string, including failure on frozen strings.
Both describe protocol-relative URLs being incorrectly rewritten onto the article host, breaking links and images.
Both describe substring-based postMessage origin validation accepting origins that should fail exact origin comparison.
Both describe unescaped URL interpolation in the import footer allowing HTML injection into unsanitized posts.
Both describe the URL and username prerequisite tests passing without exercising their guards because feed polling remains disabled.
Both describe protocol-relative href/src URLs being rewritten to the wrong host.
Both describe missing feed content causing i.content.scrub to raise and abort processing of subsequent items.
Both describe concurrent imports racing between the existing-embed check and creation, causing an unhandled unique-index violation.
Describes the same Disqus importer regression: switching to import_remote requires live HTTP retrieval, and a failed link aborts the import.
Both describe embed.css and embed.js missing from the asset precompile list, breaking production embed pages.
